notes.title: Anomaly update
notes.content:
Months of hard work at long last crystallized in a substantial update for players to enjoy! With new areas, mechanics, enemies and improvements to game throughout, Anomaly update is a lot of fun. Thank you so much to the community for playtesting, feedback, reporting issues and suggesting improvements, I couldn’t make it without your invaluable input! Keep it coming!

Here's a little trailer highlighting new area:

[previewyoutube=OjETnm8w-ic;full][/previewyoutube]

It is time to open the gates. 

What’s new? Enemies
 Boss fights
 Anomaly location
 Story

New mechanics Periodic gravity ripple
 Magnowalls
 Gravity wells
 Danger Zones® hazards
 Environmental puzzle area

Improvements Redesigned enemy spawning
 Sounds for damage effects
 Main jyotish and Habitation visual tweaks and improvements
 Boss fights improvements
 Numerous optimizations, bug fixes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9329334/87111c82b7e36be2431a8980b35581d940d2464f.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9329334/39866f8267db37d1cf5820d7b2117232cdc6fe73.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9329334/fa98539b31ed3c5f2eb8c597925849bd92f5ac48.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9329334/e1145671ff0e6ebb0adbd75b3d899a0888da15c8.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9329334/19559da3ed27c69d4ad5f58b730823842e846468.png

Please enjoy and be sure to let me know how it works for you! I'll continue to work on this and previous areas of the game so don't hesitate and leave your feedback!

Meanwhile, work on new update is starting and I’ve got some new ideas for improvements and new mechanics that I think will greatly enhance the game. Oh and new area with huge part of the story to be discovered.

MegaSphere needs your help!
Because of changes to steam and indie marketplace in general things slowed down in last few months. If you enjoy the game, and want development to move faster please help me promote it! Please wishlist, leave a review, share the game's steam page with your friends, record videos and stream it. Thank you very much for any support!

Join game's discord to discuss the game and follow me on twitter for more frequent development updates!

Thank you for being part of the game!

Anton
AK Games

notes.title: Anomaly update entering final stages!
notes.content:
At last, all mechanics and designs are in place! Here's a few new GIFs showing new mechanics and big enemies.



Spiker enemy crawls on walls and ceiling






Cryo remnant miniboss




Voltaic remnant variation




Defense remnant variation 




Stationary warpers will spawn enemies if you're nearby!





Gravity discharge wave will come on periodically, so keep to safe areas or localized stabilizers. There's even a "Portable" one.




Safeguard sneak peak!

Check out older news posts about new area I haven't showed here!

Thank you for your patience, as always! My team for last year is basically only me and development time took a hit, unfortunately. But rest assured, with your support game is being made and plan is unchanged: make it the best game it can be!

Anomaly is shaping up to be a cool unique area, so bear with me as I add sounds and polish it up for release for all to enjoy.

Remember to check twitter for more frequent updates: @antonkudin and be sure to join the game discord for discussions about game's mechanics, story or anything else!

Thank you so much for playing my game!

Anton

notes.title: Return to Anomaly
notes.content:
Hello and welcome back to Anomaly!

Its time to get a peek beyond those gates.
Heres a few WIP mechanics and enemies of the expanded Anomaly.


New MagWalls that allow you to walk on walls!


They're movable! Get ready to solve some placement puzzles ;]


Gravity wells got a fancy upgrade too


New enemy, some kind of anomalous spawn! It can conjure up gravity a vortex!




This one will fly, crawl on walls, have varying attacks. Beware!


Maybe just let them duke it out!

Thats it for now! Keep an eye out for update coming later!
Remember to check twitter for more frequent updates: @antonkudin and be sure to join the game discord for discussions about game's mechanics, story or anything else!

Thank you so much for playing my game!

notes.title: TURMS Update is live!
notes.content:
MegaSphere update with new areas, enemies and mechanics is now available!

Watch new trailer:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9329334/6b8ae29e3e912e590c73653efcbe0db8b02b8337.png

Explore two new areas for the game, meet allies and enemies, use new suit functions, solve puzzles and navigate dynamic mazes. And watch your energy bar!








Also in this update
Improvements to 'Suit restoration' objectives and beginning of the game
Updates to movement mechanics
New health mechanics
Visual and performance improvements with new rendering technique and SSAO
Frequency locating feature via interface tab
Bug fixes and other improvements

Please report any issues you find in the forums.
Thank you for being a supporter of the game!

Stay tuned for more!
Anton

Get to kicking!

notes.title: Update test phase 1!
notes.content:
Here's something for the players who want to get into early builds!



New TURMS area is finally is out in development branch (pinned post explains how to switch). New mechanics, visuals and area design in place, with final polish coming later (expect some missing/temporary sounds and dialogs).



It'd help me out if you try new update and new content specifically, and post feedback on the forums, discord (https://discord.gg/wrmJUyU) or send it directly to me via email: antonkudin@me.com).

To access new content directly: start up the game, select 'New game' and switch to 'Hacks' tab. From there, top backup will load you up right before TURMS area, as you and Novikov are about to board it from Habitation.

Several sequent backups are shortcuts throughout the new area (its pretty big), in case you get lost or stuck.

Thank you for playing my game!! ;]

notes.title: Hibernation
notes.content:
Good news! A way to instantly save current game is almost here!



Hibernate your current backup anytime you want to take a break, but don't want to search for a backup station. Due to procedural nature of the world generation, some things aren't saved, but any destruction, enemies, open doors will be saved. That said, I'm working on making it as seamless as possible.



Soon in development branch!

notes.title: Bug fix update!
notes.content:
New builds are up (for every branch, demo included).

Notable changes:

Removed trailer (will be replaced with in-game cutscene in the future)
Skippable cutscenes (Hold Jump (Space by default))
Controller support: any os, any controller.
Fully configurable controls, up to 4 bindings for any action.
Removed a brief period of invulnerability for enemies and objects when they take damage
Rebalanced rapid-fire weapons and Flamer to match DPS.
Removed tutorial section (something more fun, but similar will appear in the beginning of Anomaly)
Fixed a few ugly bugs


Thank you everyone for reporting issues, posting improvement ideas and just playing my game!

It's a dream come true for me!
Thank you very much! ;]
